extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) one row with 'dream' in lowercase under 'island' was normalized to 'Dream' for consistency; (2) three rows with negative flipper_length_mm values (rows 9, 36, 50) were excluded as they were outside the valid range [170, 235] and likely data entry errors. After fixes, the analysis shows 37 penguins measured on Biscoe, 19 on Dream, and 10 on Torgersen.
